description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2019 World Championships with the new TAG TEAM Mewtwo & Mew-GX, a popular choice that year. Its Perfection Ability lets it use the attacks of any Pokémon-GX on the Bench or in the discard pile, so the deck plays single copies of many Pokémon-GX and several ways to discard them. The 2019 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., in August 2019.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2019 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box, a pin and a code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
